seoDescription: Understand the {practiceName} patient journey from booking to telehealth visit, care plan, and follow-up.

reassuranceRows.label: Before the visit
reassuranceRows.body: You receive simple visit instructions so you know what to expect and how to prepare.

reassuranceRows.label: During the visit
reassuranceRows.body: {providerFirstName} listens, asks focused questions, and talks through the care options that fit your concern.

reassuranceRows.label: After the visit
reassuranceRows.body: You leave with plain-language next steps and follow-up guidance.

asideDescription: The care path is easy to follow: book, prepare, meet with the provider, and leave with next steps.
heroDescription: Telehealth should feel clear before the visit starts. {practiceName} makes the care journey easy to understand from the first click.
journeyTitle: Book once. Know what comes next.
journeyDescription: The path is intentionally simple: choose a time, prepare for the visit, meet with the provider, and leave with a plan.
prepTitle: A little prep helps the visit feel easier.
prepDescription: This telemedicine visit is scheduled to discuss current health concerns, review symptoms, assess medications, and address questions or follow-up care needs. Please join the video appointment 5-10 minutes early using the provided link.
feeNote: Service fees vary depending on the length and complexity of the visit.
reassuranceTitle: The process should feel calm before the visit begins.
urgentNote: If symptoms feel urgent, choose urgent or emergency care right away.
closingDescription: Book through the practice scheduling link, and the next steps are explained from there.
heroTitle: From booking to next steps, the path stays clear.
